en: Could this be...the <CLT=cltSTRONG>53rd<CLT=cltNORMAL> one?

Ding, ding! Correct! This is the 53rd season
of Danganronpa!

In other words, Danganronpa V3's official
name is <CLT=cltSTRONG>Danganronpa 53<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Starting with the Hope's Peak Academy arc
in Danganronpa 1, 2, then 3...

The seasons just kept coming, and with it
came more killing games...

Until it transcended games and anime to
become this, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Real Fiction<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

And now, we're in the 53rd season of
Danganronpa!
Th-The 53rd season!?

What, did the letter in there throw 
you off? Well, I guess that happens.

But isn't it just rad how it looks like 
a letter but it's really a number!?

Our title is "<CLT=cltSTRONG>the 53rd<CLT=cltNORMAL>," as this is the
53rd game we have masterminded.

It was supposed to be a hint...
But...whatever... I'm over it...

Since this is the 53rd season, one would
expect to see a multitude of characters...

But you only have memories from the first 
two, so you wouldn't recognize any others.

That's why I've limited myself to only 
cosplaying as Hope's Peak characters.

Is it sinkin' in yet? This killing game is just
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>53rd season of Danganronpa<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
The 53rd Danganronpa...

Trapped in a fictional, Danganronpa-inspired
world, and forced to play the killing game...
That is what the world desired from you.

So yes, I'm the mastermind! But the *real* 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind<CLT=cltNORMAL> forcing you to do this is...
...the <CLT=cltSTRONG>people of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

The people of the outside world are the
ones who are forcing you to do this!
The whole world...is the real mastermind?

The reason I made this world... 
The reason you guys did the killing game...

It's all because the outside world
wants it, you know?

It's not just me. It's everyone
involved in this <CLT=cltSTRONG>project<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
...Project?

Whaaaat? You don't know what that is?
Is your brain leaking oil or something?

The ones managing this killing game aren't
psychos like the Remnants of Despair...
They're literal managers! Literally!

So I want to hear your best guess.
What company is running this show?
